thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-1760054321 — p99 latency > 2.1s for /v1/generate (eu-west). SLO burn 18% over last 5m. Autopager engaged.
jamie: acked. I'm on it, switching to on-call context.
leo: oncall handover in 8m, tagging for visibility @marta @ashley :eyes:
marta: seeing the p99 spike, looks correlated with long KV cache misses on sidecars. Telemetry shows increase in tokenizer coldstarts.
ashley: customer-facing? any errors returned to customers or just slow?
jamie: mostly high latency, 500s are stable. No spike in 5xxs yet. Customers will see slow responses.
incident-bot: Note: autopager threshold reached -> escalated to rotation. Next escalation in 6m if unacked by rotation.
leo: heading to zoom, will take bridge if jamie needs escalation.
jamie: plan: 1) throttle long-running batched jobs via rate-limiter 2) enable fallback route to quantized-small model for non-high-accuracy routes 3) pre-warm tokenizers on canary nodes.
marta: quick check — can we divert 20% traffic to eu-central fallback pool? config change below:
```
rbctl routing set-weight --route /v1/generate --region eu-west --weight 0.8
rbctl routing set-weight --route /v1/generate --region eu-central --weight 0.2
```
ashley: do we need an approval for routing divert? ops-runner has perms.
ops-runner: I can run that, want me to apply now?
jamie: yes apply now. Also start KV cache warmup on eu-central nodes: `kubectl exec -n inference warmup -- ./warm_tokens.sh --prefetch 2000`
ops-runner: applying routing change now.
ops-runner: routing change applied. Confirmed 20% diverted to eu-central.
incident-bot: Autopager note: manual diversion detected, suppression window extended by 10m to avoid churn.
leo: good call. Keep an eye on tail latency graphs.
marta: starting tokenizer warmup on 3 canary nodes. ETA ~90s.
jamie: also reducing max batch size on the eu-west sidecars to reduce head-of-line blocking: `rbctl config set batch.max_size 16 --selector region=eu-west`
ops-runner: batch change pushed.
ashley: pinging support to prepare customer message draft in case latency persists.
ops-runner: telemetry shows p99 dropping from 2.1s -> 1.5s in the diverted pool; eu-west still at ~1.9s.
jamie: good trend. keep diversion and warmup for 10m, then we can gradually shift back.
leo: oncall transfer: I'm now primary. jamie handing off.
jamie: handoff complete. I will stay monitoring for 15m.
marta: warmup complete, KV miss rate down 45% on canaries.
ops-runner: p99 eu-west now at 1.4s after batch cap + warmup + diversion. SLO burn falling to 4%.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-1760054321 status: acknowledged -> under investigation -> mitigation in progress.
ashley: Support prep: drafted short message for impacted customers (no action needed) — will wait 15m for stabilization before sending.
leo: agree. If p99 < 1.5s and stable for 10m, we close the incident.
jamie: setting a 10m watch. If it regresses, we escalate to model-swap rollback plan.
ops-runner: adding brief note to incident timeline: `diverted 20% traffic -> applied batch cap -> tokenizer warmup -> p99 reduced`.
leo: thanks all. Useful runbook adjustments after this: consider adaptive prewarm when coldstart token miss rate > 2% and a temporary autopager throttle for batch size oscillation.
marta: noted — I'll file a short post-incident doc with telemetry + config diffs.
jamie: marking duty handoff in 10.
incident-bot: No further autopager escalations scheduled. Will re-enable automated paging if SLO burn > 10% for next 5m.
leo: closing bridge for now but keeping channel open for check-ins. :thumbsup:
